description: Hop dong van chuyen - sua quyen chon tuyen, hoan vi cac khoan bao hiem, them boi thuong

changes.description: Thay doi quyen chon tuyen: tu 'tu chon toi uu' sang 'theo chi dinh cua Ben thue'

changes.description: Hoan vi thu tu: dieu kien tai xe len dau, bao hiem xuong sau
